H2252.name: Habaiah
H2252.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2252.brief: A priest whose descendants were unable to prove their lineage.
H2252.short: Habaiah was a priest whose descendants were excluded from the priesthood due to insufficient genealogical records.

H2265.name: Habakkuk
H2265.desc: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2265.brief: A prophet who questioned God's justice.
H2265.short: Habakkuk, a prophet, wrote the book bearing his name, which records his dialogue with God about justice and faith.

H2262.name: Habazziniah
H2262.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2262.brief: Grandfather of Jaazaniah, a Rechabite leader.
H2262.short: Habazziniah was the grandfather of Jaazaniah, a leader of the Rechabites during Jeremiah's time.

H2285.name: Hagab
H2285.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2285.brief: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
H2285.short: Hagab was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity, as recorded in Ezra.

H2286B.name: Hagabah
H2286B.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2286B.brief: A temple servant who returned from Babylonian exile.
H2286B.short: Hagabah, also known as Hagaba, was among the temple servants who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity.

H2292A.name: Haggai
H2292A.desc: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
H2292A.brief: A prophet who encouraged the rebuilding of the temple.
H2292A.short: Haggai, a prophet during the post-exilic period, urged the people to rebuild the temple in Jerusalem.

H2291.name: Haggi
H2291.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2291.brief: Son of Gad, grandson of Jacob.
H2291.short: Haggi was a son of Gad and a grandson of Jacob, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis and Numbers.

H2293.name: Haggiah
H2293.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2293.short: Haggiah, a Levite descended from Merari, is mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites in 1 Chronicles.

H2294.name: Haggith
H2294.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H2294.brief: One of David's wives; mother of Adonijah.
H2294.short: Haggith was one of King David's wives and the mother of Adonijah, who attempted to claim the throne.

H2268I.name: Heber
H2268I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2268I.brief: Son of Mered, from the tribe of Judah.
H2268I.short: Heber was a son of Mered, from the tribe of Judah.

H2268J.name: Heber
H2268J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2268J.short: Heber was a Benjamite, one of the sons of Elpaal.

H2268G.name: Heber
H2268G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2268G.brief: Son of Beriah, grandson of Asher.
H2268G.short: Heber was a son of Beriah and grandson of Asher.

H2268H.name: Heber
H2268H.short: Heber the Kenite; husband of Jael. He had separated from the Kenites and allied with Jabin, king of Hazor.

H2275I.name: Hebron
H2275I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2275I.brief: Son of Mareshah, from the tribe of Judah.
H2275I.short: Hebron was a son of Mareshah, a descendant of Caleb from the tribe of Judah.

H2275B.name: Hebron
H2275B.desc: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2275B.brief: Son of Kohath, grandson of Levi.
H2275B.short: Hebron was a son of Kohath and grandson of Levi, and his descendants were known as the Hebronites.

H2246.name: Hobab
H2246.desc: Midianite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2246.short: Hobab, the son of Jethro (or 'Reuel') the Midianite and Moses' brother-in-law, was invited by Moses to join the Israelites on their journey to the Promised Land.

H2295.name: Hoglah
H2295.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2295.brief: Daughter of Zelophehad, of the tribe of Manasseh.
H2295.short: Hoglah was one of the five daughters of Zelophehad who received an inheritance in the Promised Land due to their father's lack of male heirs.

H2240G.name: Zattu
H2240G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2240G.short: Zattu was the ancestor of a family that returned to Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H2240H.name: Zattu
H2240H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2240H.brief: Israelite leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
H2240H.short: Zattu was one of the leaders of Israel who sealed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H2226J.name: Zerah
H2226J.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2226J.short: Zerah, a Levite of the Gershonite clan, was the son of Iddo.

H2226K.name: Zerah
H2226K.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2226K.short: Zerah the Ethiopian led a vast army against Judah but was defeated by King Asa.

H2226G.name: Zerah
H2226G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2226G.brief: Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau
H2226G.short: Zerah, a son of Reuel and grandson of Esau, was a chief of Edom.

H2226H.name: Zerah
H2226H.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2226H.short: Zerah, from Bozrah, was a king of Edom before Israel had a king.

H2226I.name: Zerah
H2226I.desc: Judah's son living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2226I.brief: Son of Judah, twin of Perez
H2226I.short: Zerah, son of Judah and Tamar, was the twin brother of Perez and ancestor of Achan.

forms.meaning: “a native (as arising out of the soil)”

H2226L.name: Zerah
H2226L.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2226L.brief: Son of Simeon; ancestor of the Zerahites
H2226L.short: Zerah (or Zohar), a son of Simeon, was the ancestor of the Zerahite clan.

H2228G.name: Zerahiah
H2228G.desc: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2228G.short: Zerahiah (or Ahitub), a priest, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe.

H2228H.name: Zerahiah
H2228H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2228H.brief: Descendant of Pahath-Moab who returned with Ezra
H2228H.short: Zerahiah, a descendant of Pahath-Moab, led 200 men in the return to Jerusalem with Ezra.

H2238.name: Zeresh
H2238.desc: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
H2238.brief: Wife of Haman, enemy of the Jews
H2238.short: Zeresh, the wife of Haman, advised him to have Mordecai hanged on a gallows.

H2216.name: Zerubbabel
H2216.desc: Governor living at the time of Exile and Return
H2216.brief: Leader of the first Jewish exiles from Babylon
H2216.short: Zerubbabel (or Sheshbazzar), a descendant of David, led the first group of Jewish exiles back to Jerusalem from Babylon and oversaw the rebuilding of the temple.

H2241.name: Zetham
H2241.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2241.brief: Son of Laadan, a Gershonite Levite
H2241.short: Zetham, a son of Laadan, was a Gershonite Levite during the time of David.

H2242.name: Zethar
H2242.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2242.brief: One of the seven eunuchs of King Ahasuerus
H2242.short: Zethar was one of the seven eunuchs who served King Ahasuerus of Persia.

H2249.name: Habor
H2249.brief: A river in Assyria where Israelite captives were settled.
H2249.short: Habor was a river in Assyria along which the Israelite captives from the northern kingdom were settled by the Assyrians (<ref="2Ki.17.6; 18:11; 1Ch.5.26">2Ki.17.6; 18:11; 1Ch.5.26</ref>).

H2275A.name: Hebron
H2275A.brief: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.
H2275A.short: Hebron, also known as Kiriath-arba, was a significant city in Judah, associated with the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and later became a Levitical city and a city of refuge.

H2275H.name: Hebron Valley
H2275H.brief: Valley near Hebron where Joseph sought his brothers
H2275H.short: The Hebron Valley was the location where Joseph was sent by his father, Jacob, to check on his brothers who were pasturing their flocks near Shechem (<ref="Gen.37.14">Gen.37.14</ref>).

H2218.name: Zered
H2218.brief: A brook marking the end of Israel's wilderness wanderings
H2218.short: The Zered Brook marked the end of Israel's 38 years of wilderness wanderings until they crossed it to enter Moab .

H2202.name: Ziphron
H2202.brief: A place on the northern border of the Promised Land
H2202.short: Ziphron was a place on the northern border of the Promised Land .
